# Kezza Hair & Skin Clinic

> Kezza Hair & Skin Clinic is a premium hair transplant and skin care clinic
> operating in Jaipur, Sikar, and Ajmer, Rajasthan, India. Specialist services
> include FUE & DHI hair transplants, PRP & GFC hair therapy, white & grey hair
> removal (Kezza Medline Micro-Epilation), advanced skin treatments, permanent
> makeup (PMU), scalp micropigmentation (SMP), non-surgical weight loss, and a
> free AI-powered face & scalp assessment tool.

## About

- Clinics in Jaipur, Sikar, and Ajmer, Rajasthan, India
- Expert dermatologists and certified hair transplant surgeons
- Primary Contact: +91-9284517427
- Website: https://kezzaclinic.com
- Open: Monday – Sunday, 10:00 AM – 8:00 PM

## Medical Team

- Dr. Ankit Bhalothia — Aesthetic & Hair Transplant Surgeon (Jaipur & Sikar)
- Dr. Nakul Somani — Aesthetic & Reconstructive Plastic Surgeon (Jaipur), trained at Sir Ganga Ram Hospital, Delhi & Cocoona Dubai
- Dr. Mandhata Sharma — ENT, Rhinoplasty & Head & Neck Surgeon (Jaipur), MS Gold Medalist from MAMC Delhi
- Dr. Youvraj Singh — Consultant Physician & Internal Medicine Specialist, MBBS, MD (Jaipur)

## Services

- [Hair Transplant — FUE & DHI](https://kezzaclinic.com/hair-transplant/): Surgical follicular restoration using FUE, DHI, and sapphire techniques in Jaipur, Sikar & Ajmer
- [PRP Therapy](https://kezzaclinic.com/prp-therapy.html): Autologous Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP) hair regrowth therapy in Jaipur
- [GFC Therapy](https://kezzaclinic.com/prp-therapy.html#gfc-therapy): Acellular Growth Factor Concentrate (GFC) — advanced hair restoration in Jaipur
- [White & Grey Hair Removal](https://kezzaclinic.com/white-hair-removal.html): Kezza Medline Micro-Epilation — permanent removal of laser-resistant white, grey & blonde hair
- [Skin Care & Dermatology](https://kezzaclinic.com/skin-services.html): HydraFacial, carbon peel, fractional CO2 laser, Botox, acne scar removal, anti-aging in Jaipur
- [Permanent Makeup (PMU)](https://kezzaclinic.com/permanent-makeup.html): Microblading, ombre brows, lip blush, permanent eyeliner in Jaipur
- [Scalp Micropigmentation (SMP)](https://kezzaclinic.com/permanent-makeup.html): Non-surgical hair follicle simulation for thinning hair and alopecia
- [Non-Surgical Weight Loss](https://kezzaclinic.com/weight-loss.html): Cryolipolysis, HIFU body sculpting & personalised weight management programs
- [AI Face & Scalp Scanner](https://kezzaclinic.com/face-scanner.html): Free AI-powered preliminary skin and scalp assessment tool
